description: This Kotlin source file defines the `AstrologyWidgetProvider` class, which is an `AppWidgetProvider` responsible for updating an astrology widget in an Android application. It initializes a database repository, retrieves astrology details asynchronously, and updates the widget UI.

classes.name: AstrologyWidgetProvider
classes.description: An AppWidgetProvider that updates an astrology widget by fetching astrology details from the database and updating the widget UI.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Called to update the widget(s). Initializes database and repository, then updates each widget.

methods.name: updateAstrologyWidget
methods.description: Fetches astrology details asynchronously and updates the widget UI.
